profile.reading: This is the Centro Elaborazione Dati Catocci Bianciardi, a small third party data processing bureau at Via del Paradiso 41 in Siena, Italy, formally registered as S.A.S. Centro Elaborazione Dati Catocci Bianciardi di Bari Simone, Bianciardi Susanna e Vanni Serena, a limited partnership. This registrys prior operator label, Bari Bianciardi Vanni, reflects the surnames of the businesss three partners, Simone Bari, Susanna Bianciardi, and Serena Vanni, rather than a place name, and the business is in fact located in Siena rather than the city of Bari, a correction this registry records directly. Italian business registry records show the partnership was incorporated February 1, 1994, and classify its activity under ATECO code 63102, elaborazione dati per conto terzi, or data processing services on behalf of third parties, the classic small town data processing bureau model common in Italy from the 1970s and 1980s onward, historically handling outsourced payroll, accounting, and similar back office data work for local businesses that did not maintain their own computing staff. The business is currently listed with a single employee, consistent with its scale as a small, longstanding local service provider rather than a modern commercial data center or colocation facility. Siena is a historic Tuscan city built on tourism and its medieval university and banking heritage, home to Monte dei Paschi di Siena, one of the worlds oldest surviving banks, and small local data processing bureaus of this kind historically served the regions many small and mid sized businesses, artisans, and professional firms that needed outsourced bookkeeping and payroll computation before in-house computing became affordable, a service model this business appears to continue in a much smaller and more specialized form today.
